title: Fi Collar Escape Geofence Event Count
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fi:activity event=geofence_exit
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as exits by pet _time
| where exits>0
| sort - exits
description: Uses Fi geofence events telemetry to monitor how often pets leave approved zones in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for escape patterns that need better fencing or alerts, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Fi geofence events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags how often pets leave approved zones so you can spot escape patterns that need better fencing or alerts before it becomes annoying.
